The geometry is the main task. Seven opposing pairs, fourteen individual full-height slim bamboo shafts. Each pair meets at exactly one existing green-wire joint along one mostly horizontal ridge; each member extends from its slightly projecting tip across that junction continuously to one anchored foot.
